label: Initial configuration API views
instruction: Generate a compact DRF API view file (max 75 lines) providing ConfigurationView GET current LeavePolicy, LeaveCalendar and LeaveType rows; PUT saves submitted policy and calendar configuration using existing serializers and models. Include RecordListView GET LeaveHistory and LeaveNotification rows for request.principal.user_id as JSON values. Use existing configuration.manage and record.manage permission interfaces, HasModuleGrant, no duplicate models. This is initial implementation for configuration and records, not a request to audit or repair workflow logic.
